Subject: MAP draft and next steps for go-live acceptance

Jasmine — thanks again for walking us through the eval last week. The procurement team asked me to capture the acceptance gate and start date so they can align PO timing. I attached the MAP (v5) with the evaluation criteria and the acceptance checklist. A few asks from our side: 

- Final confirmation of who signs the SOW and typical signer lead time (we have a tentative start week of Feb 15).
- Any blackout dates for provisioning or training in the week following signature.
- Can you confirm Redwood's standard remediation window if an eval regression is found during acceptance (we capture a fix plan in the MAP).

We'd like to lock the signature date by Jan 25 if possible so our legal + procurement can process the PO.

Thanks — Helen
Helen Cho
Director, Product Operations | AcmeTech
helen.cho@acmetech.com

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.example>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft and next steps for go-live acceptance

Hi Helen — appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

- Signer & lead time: Redwood typically needs sign-off from a VP-level procurement or legal contact; once the final SOW is issued we generally see a 3–5 business day turnaround for signature if the PO is ready. If Acme can circulate the PO concurrently that trims the window.
- Blackout dates: No planned infra blackout for the Feb 15 week. We do advise avoiding major data migrations that week; we'll reserve the first 48 hours post-signature for provisioning and onboarding tasks.
- Remediation window: For MAP acceptance regressions we commit to a P1 response within 24 hours and a targeted remediation release within 3 business days for model-eval regressions (documented in SOW).

Next steps (proposed):
1) Redwood issues final SOW (SOW_Redwood_v3_final.pdf) by EOD Jan 19.
2) Acme to confirm preferred signature date between Jan 22–25 and circulate PO to procurement@redwood.example.
3) Final MAP acceptance call on Jan 21 to walk acceptance checklist items and assignment of owners.

Ben and Marissa — looping you in to confirm internal approver for expedited signature and to ask whether we should pre-stage any provisioning slots next week.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.example

2) Marissa — do we have a provisioning window open the week of Feb 15? If yes, please pre-allocate a 4-hour slot for initial onboarding and a separate 2-hour training window.

Goal: have SOW out by EOD Jan 19 and signature locked by Jan 25.

Thanks,
